_note: One Piece Carddass Hyper Battle (Bandai, Japan, 1999-2002): 16 sets and the promos (the Treasure Packs' reprints left out). Card list, names, rarities: Grand Line Wiki (grandlinewiki.net/tcg/carddasshyper.html). Pictures: its scans, onepiececollection.fr's where it has none, a PriceCharting photo (S-E1) and a photo cropped from a slab (C46); shrunk to 400 px (Field Point cards stood upright) and published as a release asset, fetched by fetch_cards.py HYPERBATTLE. C-J2 has no picture anywhere and is left out. refUsd: PriceCharting raw sales where there are any; "estimated": by rarity (common $4, holo $30, gold stamp $45, secret rare $150, promo $60). Sealed: vending packs (4 cards from a Stage or Grand Line Compilation; never sold in boxes) about $40, Grand Boxes (ready-made decks) from Yahoo! Auctions sales (Grand Box 5: 67,000-69,000 yen), Grand Box DX and the Jump Festa packs from asking prices.
